#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const int MOD = 998244353;
const int MOD2 = 1000000007;

namespace FastIO {
    constexpr size_t BUFSIZE = 1 << 21;
    char ibuf[BUFSIZE], *ip = ibuf, *ie = ibuf;
    char obuf[BUFSIZE], *op = obuf;
    
    inline int getc() {
        if (ip == ie) {
            ie = ibuf + fread(ibuf, 1, BUFSIZE, stdin);
            ip = ibuf;
        }
        return (ip == ie) ? EOF : *ip++;
    }
    
    template<typename T>
    inline T read() {
        char c;
        while ((c = getc()) < '0' || c > '9') {
            if (c == EOF) return -1;
            if (c == '-') {
                T x = 0;
                while ((c = getc()) >= '0' && c <= '9') x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
                return -x;
            }
        }
        T x = c - '0';
        while ((c = getc()) >= '0' && c <= '9') x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        return x;
    }
    
    inline void putc(char c) {
        *op++ = c;
        if (op - obuf >= BUFSIZE) flush();
    }
    
    inline void flush() {
        fwrite(obuf, 1, op - obuf, stdout);
        op = obuf;
    }
    
    template<typename T>
    inline void write(T x, char sep = '\n') {
        if (x < 0) { putc('-'); x = -x; }
        if (x == 0) { putc('0'); if (sep != -1) putc(sep); return; }
        char buf[20], *p = buf;
        while (x) { *p++ = '0' + (x % 10); x /= 10; }
        while (p != buf) putc(*--p);
        if (sep != -1) putc(sep);
    }
    
    inline void write(const char* s) {
        while (*s) putc(*s++);
    }
}

using namespace FastIO;

ll powers[8] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000};
int idx_counter = 0, answer = 0;
ll N, sum_by_digit[7] = {0};
int count_by_digit[7] = {0};
vector<int> values[7];

void build_first_phase(int cur, int depth) {
    int adjusted = (idx_counter - cur + MOD) % MOD;
    values[depth].push_back(adjusted);
    sum_by_digit[depth] = (sum_by_digit[depth] + adjusted) % MOD;
    count_by_digit[depth]++;
    idx_counter++;
    
    if (depth == 6) return;
    for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {
        build_first_phase(cur * 10 + d, depth + 1);
    }
}

void process_query(int base, ll position) {
    for (int d = 0; d < 7; ++d) {
        ll target = (position - 1LL * base * powers[d]) % MOD;
        if (target < 0) target += MOD;
        
        auto it = lower_bound(values[d].begin(), values[d].end(), MOD - target);
        int cnt = values[d].end() - it;
        
        int part1 = sum_by_digit[d];
        int part2 = (1LL * target * count_by_digit[d]) % MOD;
        int part3 = (1LL * (count_by_digit[d] - cnt) * MOD) % MOD;
        
        answer = (answer + part1 + part2 - part3) % MOD2;
        if (answer < 0) answer += MOD2;
    }
}

void second_phase(ll cur) {
    if ((cur + 1) * powers[6] <= N + 1 && cur * powers[7] > N) {
        process_query(cur, idx_counter + 1);
        idx_counter += idx_counter;
        return;
    }
    
    idx_counter++;
    int diff = ((idx_counter - cur) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
    answer = (answer + diff) % MOD2;
    
    for (int d = (cur == 0 ? 1 : 0); d < 10; ++d) {
        ll next_val = cur * 10 + d;
        if (next_val <= N) {
            second_phase(next_val);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    build_first_phase(0, 0);
    N = read<ll>();
    second_phase(0);
    write(answer);
    flush();
    return 0;
}
